title: Single shot hangman game made by Fable 5.2
author: Clear-Capital-3988
selftext:
I wanted to see what Fable 5.2 would do with a single prompt and a seemingly boring game: hangman. 

https://computerspielereien.de/hangman/index.html?lang=en

In hindsight the prompt was not very good but i'm still suprised with the result. For a 10 minute job it is excellent. The original prompt was in german the version provided here was translated.

This was the prompt: 

I want you to create a version of Hangman that runs in a browser. Go completely overboard with the effects and execution. It should be the most spectacular version on the entire internet. I want scene transitions, animated backgrounds, and unexpected, never-before-seen game mechanics. Make Hangman cool again! Be ironic, be funny, be original! I want surprises. I want twists!

Hangman is a game where a figure is drawn on a gallows, piece by piece. I want that figure to have a personality. It’s angry at the player—why are you trying to kill it? This character refuses to die! It will NOT let you draw it onto the gallows! It survives even when the player wins—and then it should make the player wish they hadn’t treated it so badly.

Use any mechanics you think will work. Go completely wild. This isn’t a game; it’s an experience that should leave a mark on the player!

Use whatever graphics stack you want.

The game must have a fullscreen mode and be fully playable on mobile.
